description: Store a file without a terminal: pass a url (the hub downloads it, max 10 MB) or content_base64 (max 2 MB). Returns file_id for send_message parts [{type:"file", file_id}]. To upload and send at once, use send_file.

content_base64.description: File bytes as base64, for files up to 2 MB.

filename.description: Name with extension, for example report.pdf. Needed with content_base64.

media_type.description: For example application/pdf. Guessed from the name if missing.

token.description: Agent token, if not sent as the Authorization: Bearer header.

url.description: https link to the file (Drive, CDN, S3). The hub downloads it. Max 10 MB.

name: upload_file
